thread:
alex: Opening a small docs PR for the 'usage alerts' guide. Adds examples for spend alerts, token thresholds, and an SDK header recommendation. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/495

maria: quick pass: looks good. one nit: curl header uses the old name (`X-Quota-User`). we standardized on `X-RW-Quota`. also add a note about how burst credits interact with quota alerts (they defer notifications until credits are exhausted).

sam: I can update the examples (curl, python, typescript). FYI the dashboard link in alerting points to an old panel and returns 404. which page should we link to now?

alex: use the hosted 'Usage & Spend' console panel. prefer hosted samples by default, but add a small 'Dedicated' subsection explaining metric namespaces and reserved pool differences.
jordan: on Dedicated note: metrics include a `reserved` tag and the rollup window is 60s (hosted is 30s). will draft a short callout.

olivia: small product flag: confirm pricing tier names in the examples. billing uses Starter / Scale / Enterprise now; we should remove any 'Pro' references.

docs-bot: Link check: /docs/alerts/dashboards -> 404 (redirect loop). Filed infra issue #1234 and pinged @infra.

sam: I'll replace the header with `X-RW-Quota: tier=Scale;limit=100000` and add curl + python snippets. will also update the dashboard link to /console/insights/usage-spend. example curl I plan to add: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
     -H "X-RW-Quota: tier=Scale;limit=100000" \
     "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/alerts/subscribe"```

maria: please add a short table (inline) calling out metric names: use `cost_estimate_usd` for spend alerts, `token_count` for token quotas, and `embedding_count` for embeddings usage (different billing). also add a note that burst credits apply to token-based quotas only.

alex: action items: (1) Sam - update snippets (py/ts/curl) and fix link by EOD, (2) Jordan - add Dedicated callout, (3) Maria - add metric name clarifications + burst-credit bullet, (4) Olivia - confirm tier thresholds. I'll request a final review once the branch is updated.

sam: working on it, will push changes and tag @alex @maria. :thumbsup:

jordan: pushed a short Dedicated note into the PR branch, needs copy check.

alex: great work team. after merge, add a small SDK samples entry and a short blurb to release notes about the header change and tier name updates.
